$$

By applying elementary row operations of the form $R_{i}:=R_{i}+kR_{2},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the elementary row operations?
question.:question/worked-solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make the entries above and below $a_{23}=-1$ equal to $0.$

$$
\begin{bmatrix}-2 & 6 & 4 \\ 6 & -3 & -1 \\ 4 & 11 & 9\end{bmatrix}
\xrightarrow{R_{1}:=R_{1}+4R_{2}}\begin{bmatrix}22 & -6 & 0 \\ 6 & -3 & -1 \\ 4 & 11 & 9\end{bmatrix}
\xrightarrow{R_{3}:=R_{3}+9R_{2}}\begin{bmatrix}22 & -6 & 0 \\ 6 & -3 & -1 \\ 58 & -16 & 0\end{bmatrix}=B
$$

Therefore, the elementary row operations are

$R_{1}:=R_{1}+4R_{2}$ and $R_{3}:=R_{3}+9R_{2}$.
